text_en: When any of you has a grievance against another, do you dare to take it to court before the unrighteous, instead of taking it before the saints?
text_cn: 你们中间有人与另一人有了争讼，怎么竟敢在不义的人面前起诉，而不在圣者面前呢？

text_en: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is to be judged by you, are you incompetent to try trivial cases?
text_cn: 你们不知道圣者将要审判世界吗？如果世界要受你们审判，难道你们不配审判一些小事吗？

text_en: Do you not know that we are to judge angels—to say nothing of ordinary matters?
text_cn: 你们不知道我们连天使都要审判吗？更何况日常生活的事呢？

text_en: If you have ordinary cases, then, do you appoint as judges those who have no standing in the church?
text_cn: 所以，若你们在日常生活上有了应审判的事，就请那些在教会内受轻视的人来裁判吧！

text_en: I say this to your shame. Can it be that there is no one among you wise enough to decide between one believer and another,
text_cn: 我说这话，是为叫你们羞愧；难道你们中间竟没有一个有智慧的人，能在自己弟兄中间分辨是非，

text_en: but a believer goes to court against a believer —and before unbelievers at that?
text_cn: 以致弟兄与弟兄互相控告，且在无信仰的人面前控告？

text_en: In fact, to have lawsuits at all with one another is already a defeat for you. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
text_cn: 你们彼此有诉讼的事，就各方面讲，已是你们的缺点了；那么，你们为什么不宁愿受点屈？为什么不宁愿吃点亏？

text_en: But you yourselves wrong and defraud—and believers at that.
text_cn: 你们反而使人受屈，使人吃亏，况且这还是施于弟兄！

text_en: Do you not know that wrongdoers will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived! Fornicators, idolaters, adulterers, male prostitutes, sodomites,
text_cn: 你们岂不知道，不义的人不得承继天主的国吗？你们不要自欺：无论是淫荡的、或拜偶像的、犯奸淫的、作娈(luán)童的、好男色的、

text_en: thieves, the greedy, drunkards, revilers, robbers—none of these will inherit the kingdom of God.
text_cn: 偷窃的、贪婪的、酗酒的、辱骂人的、勒索人的，都不能承继天主的国。

text_en: And this is what some of you used to be. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and in the Spirit of our God.
text_cn: 你们中从前也有这样的人，但是你们因着【我们的】主耶稣基督之名，并因我们天主的圣神，已经洗净了，已经祝圣了，已经成了义人。

text_en: “All things are lawful for me, ” but not all things are beneficial. “All things are lawful for me, ” but I will not be dominated by anything.
text_cn: “凡事我都可行，”但不全有益；“凡事我都可行，”但我却不受任何事物的管制。

text_en: “Food is meant for the stomach and the stomach for food, ” and God will destroy both one and the other. The body is meant not for fornication but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
text_cn: “食物是为肚腹，肚腹是为食物，”但天主把这两样都要废弃；人的身体不是为淫乱，而是为主，主也是为身体。

text_en: And God raised the Lord and will also raise us by his power.
text_cn: 天主既使主复活了，他也要以自己的能力使我们复活。

text_en: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Should I therefore take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? Never!
text_cn: 你们不知道你们的身体是基督的肢体吗？我岂可拿基督的肢体作为娼妓的肢体？断乎不可！

text_en: Do you not know that whoever is united to a prostitute becomes one body with her? For it is said, “The two shall be one flesh. ”
text_cn: 你们岂不知道那与娼妓结合的，便是与她成为一体吗？因为经上说：‘二人成为一体。’

text_en: But anyone united to the Lord becomes one spirit with him.
text_cn: 但那与主结合的，便是与他成为一神。

text_en: Shun fornication! Every sin that a person commits is outside the body; but the fornicator sins against the body itself.
text_cn: 你们务要远离邪淫。人无论犯的是什么罪，都是在身体以外；但是，那犯邪淫的，却是冒犯自己的身体。

text_en: Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you, which you have from God, and that you are not your own?
text_cn: 难道你们不知道，你们的身体是圣神的宫殿，这圣神是你们由天主而得的，住在你们内，而你们已不是属于自己的了吗？

text_en: For you were bought with a price; therefore glorify God in your body.
text_cn: 你们原是用高价买来的，所以务要用你们的身体光荣天主。
